title: Path Blur + Dissolve
description: Carries the source itself through a bounded directional trail and stable grain-like displacement.

parameters.label: Trail Length
parameters.description: Length of the directional image trail.

parameters.label: Blur
parameters.description: Balance between the sharp source and its trail.

parameters.label: Dissolve
parameters.description: How much of the trail breaks back into sharp image.

parameters.label: Path Motion
parameters.description: Slow coherent drift and breathing of the trail.
